name: com.xaminat/xaminat
title: Xaminat
description: Website checks that detect accessibility, privacy, consumer law, security, SEO and speed issues.

tools.name: start_launch_inspection
tools.description: Run automated checks on a live website or web app to detect potential legal, accessibility, privacy, consumer law, security, SEO and speed issues. Use when the user is about to launch, publish or deploy a site, or asks if it is legal, compliant, accessible or ready to go live. Returns an inspection ID; then call get_launch_inspection. Free: up to 5 pages, 3 a day. A licence key unlocks up to 25 pages and full explanations; on a site the user has verified (verify_site), it also runs the security checks. Reports on sites the user does not own are private, labelled unverified, and never include security testing. The inspector honours robots.txt opt-outs.

url.description: The public website address, for example https://example.com

business_type.description: Optional. One or more of: consultancy, personal-services (hair, beauty, tattoo), trades, health, hospitality, retail, digital (SaaS, apps, courses), creative (music, art), fitness-events, kids-education, regulated-pro (finance, legal, real estate), nonprofit, marketplace. Join two with "+", e.g. "creative+retail". Leave out to detect it.

max_pages.description: Optional. Pages to check (free: up to 5).

tools.name: get_launch_inspection
tools.description: Get the status and results of a launch inspection. Waits up to about 25 seconds for a running inspection; if it is still running, call again. When done, returns the launch status (Not launch ready / Ready, with fixes to schedule / Passed), each finding with its severity, where it is, why it matters (the law or standard) and how to fix it, plus a link to the full visual report.

tools.name: explain_launch_check
tools.description: Explain one Xaminat check by its number (for example "6.1" or "15.7"), or list a whole section (for example "15"), with what passing looks like. Use to explain a finding or to plan fixes.

check.description: A check number such as "6.1", or a section number such as "15"

tools.name: verify_site
tools.description: Prove the user owns a website so Xaminat can run the full inspection, including security checks and leaked-key details, and give a shareable "passed these checks" link. Call with action "start" to get a code and three ways to publish it (meta tag, file or DNS record), help the user publish it, then call with action "check". Needs a licence key.

tools.name: list_business_types
tools.description: List the business types Xaminat judges sites by (a hairdresser is checked differently from a consultancy or a health clinic), with each one's focus areas and extra checks. Use to pick business_type for an inspection.

type.description: Optional. One type to show in full, e.g. "personal-services"
